title: Megurine Luka — Guiding Hand〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hello.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh?
Just the two of you today?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, we have something to talk to you about today...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Me?
What is it?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, well... We wanted to say thank you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Whatever for?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For calling me to this SEKAI, and...helping me to face my feelings honestly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much for all of that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me at all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You were able to face your feelings because you wanted to, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not really... I wouldn't have been able to do it on my own.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It was because of everyone's encouragement and that starlit sky from our memories.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See? I didn't do anything at all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Remember we told you that this SEKAI is made from your feelings?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That starlit sky only appeared here because it had remained in everyone's memories.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You saw it because it remained in your memories too, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But Ichika told me that it was you and Miku who suggested showing me the starlit sky back then.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So I still think I should say thank you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's not like I did anything special...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I'm glad that motivated you to face your feelings.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Excuse me... Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Uh, well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm the same.
I wanted to thank you too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It was because of you and Miku that I decided to join the band Ichika started and patch things up with Honami.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
So...
Thank you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it.
I was only doing what I wanted.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm so glad all of you found your true feelings.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It feels so good to be able to say thank you properly. Huh? Shiho? Why are you holding a bass guitar?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I feel like playing.
Join me, Honami and Luka.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? I don't mind, but this is very sudden.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just come on.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, maybe Shiho is feeling happy?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh? Is it because you don't know what to say?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Honami, start counting already!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah, g-give me a second, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's play a great tune together, girls.
